tool_args.rationale: The pilot supports a gradient-modulated siphon driving a coupled memory ODE. The fine trajectory batch is the available measurement that adds transient information and brings the training set to at least eight rows before fitting the five parameters.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter coupled ODE now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five endpoint observations leave no residual degrees of freedom, and all horizons are long relative to the characteristic timescale, making the fast relaxation difficult to distinguish from coupling strength.

considered_alternatives.option: Uncoupled Kelvin–Voigt creep or damped oscillator
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Neither model represents the observed sink-gradient dependence or coupled memory lag.
It does not resolve the coupling and relaxation ambiguity.
